title: senebiera didyma
intro: Senebiera didyma, commonly known as Mexican tea tree or hoja de limon, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae. It is used as a medicinal herb to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate digestive problems, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Senebiera didyma include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for wound healing, skin issues, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
